achievement.name: Open Source Contributions
achievement.description: Pull requests authored by the subject and merged into public open source projects.

criteria.narrative: Each listed contribution is a pull request that the upstream maintainers merged. The workflow re-checks authorship and merge status against the GitHub API on every run, and refuses to issue the credential if any listed contribution fails that check.
